This '''estate''' was the residence of [[Hetton's family]] located in a region directly outside [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Carannia/Legends|Carannia]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. It comprised an [[Hetton's great mansion|enormous mansion]] and lavish [[Rose (flower)/Legends|rose]] [[Garden/Legends|gardens]] that stretched for acres.<ref name="RoT" />
